study_system.region: Peck Ranch and adjoining Ozark glade systems, Missouri, USA
study_system.scientific_role: fresh independent candidate for the post-Glanville two-layer EOG-WF predictor

scientific_process_basis.known_founder_program: three Stegall Mountain glades received translocated populations beginning in 1984, 1987 and 1989
scientific_process_basis.management_transition: prescribed woodland fire began in 1994 and changed matrix permeability/dispersal
published_dynamic_phases: isolated translocated populations with little/no dispersal and colonisation
approximately stable metapopulation from about 2000 on Stegall Mountain
scientific_process_basis.published_patch_process: the 2011 Ecology study explicitly analyses annual initial colonisation, recolonisation, extinction/turnover, occupied glades and nearest previously occupied source glades
scientific_process_basis.historical_claim_boundary: Known translocations may define declared initial sources; EOG still does not infer one unique historical route for later colonisations.

ecological_archives_figshare.role: stable publisher-linked supporting-information route for the 2011 Ecology article, including the demographic supplement/appendices if present
ecological_archives_figshare.gate0_action: enumerate collection article/file metadata and checksum all downloadable machine-readable files; do not parse demographic data rows

dryad_documentation.role: documentation/provenance only at Gate 0 unless a stable non-challenge byte route becomes available
dryad_documentation.documented_rows: row 1 header; rows 2-6746 are capture/recapture or glade-survey records
dryad_documentation.documented_zero_capture_semantics: the README states that sometimes no captures occurred on a glade and capture-related fields are then entered as n/a

response_semantics_gate.target_question: Can annual survey-recorded glade occupancy/colonisation be reconstructed without treating unsurveyed glade-years as absence?
response_semantics_gate.candidate_positive: surveyed glade-year with at least one recorded lizard/capture or a publisher-provided positive population estimate
response_semantics_gate.candidate_negative: explicitly surveyed glade-year with zero captures/zero estimated population under a source field that distinguishes it from an unsurveyed glade-year
response_semantics_gate.forbidden_negative: a missing glade-year, absent row, missing population estimate, or not-monitored year must never be recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.gate0_pass_requirement: README/schema/supporting tables must make surveyed-zero versus unsurveyed/missing status mechanically distinguishable before any individual demographic data values are inspected
response_semantics_gate.fallback_if_binary_negatives_fail: positive-only sequential rule contraction may be scientifically possible, but it is insufficient for the current fresh Layer-B binary predictive validation goal; stop this candidate rather than changing the endpoint after response access

allowed_at_gate0: full GPS waypoint text and derived coordinate schema because it is response-free
Figshare collection/article/file metadata including names, sizes, checksums and download URLs
Excel workbook sheet names and dimensions
header rows/column labels only from demographic spreadsheets/tables
file bytes solely for checksum/container metadata before row parsing
forbidden_before_gate0_semantics_pass: counts of occupied/unoccupied glades by year computed from response tables
response-driven node definition, world scale, feature selection or holdout choice

node_geometry_gate.provisional_node_unit: glade or explicitly mapped glade-section, to be resolved only from GPS names plus response schema before demographic values
requirements: stable names can be mapped deterministically between the spatial source and the demographic schema
at least three distinct response-blind structural LCC scales are possible under the reused generic scale-diversity rule
no node is added because it happens to contain a favourable response

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule identities retained for sequential compatibility, contraction and finite-universe falsification

pass_if_all: Figshare publisher-linked supporting files and Zenodo GPS bytes can be reproducibly frozen
spatial node names/coordinates are machine-readable and deterministic
demographic schema has an explicit way to distinguish surveyed zero from not surveyed/missing without reading biological outcome values
a temporal sequence with enough monitored years for a heldout design exists from documentation/schema
conditional internal-source glade-metapopulation interpretation remains scientifically defensible
stop_if_any: stable response-bearing source bytes cannot be frozen
survey zero versus unsurveyed cannot be distinguished
node names cannot be reconciled without inspecting outcomes
only positive capture events are available with no auditable negative/effort semantics for Layer-B evaluation

post_gate0_sequence: freeze canonical node unit and full response-free geometry
run the same response-blind structural scale/adequacy gate used after Glanville
freeze known founder/current-source semantics and management/world rules
freeze symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 and strong metapopulation/nearest-source comparators
freeze temporal calibration/heldout split using metadata only
only then open demographic response rows once
no_rescue_rule: If source, response semantics, node mapping or structural adequacy fails before response access, stop without changing the endpoint or introducing post-hoc graph worlds.
